The *Gandhatindukajātaka* (Ja 520) is a narrative included in the Pali Jātaka collection [SuttaCentral]. According to its opening nidāna, the Buddha related this story while residing at Jetavana concerning the admonition of a king [SuttaCentral]. The text is also referenced in later paracanonical exegetical treatises, namely the *Nettippakaraṇa* (Catubyūhahāravibhaṅga) and the *Peṭakopadesa* (Hāravibhaṅgapañcamabhūmi) [SuttaCentral].
